subject: Offer authorization: Elias Moreno — Senior Serving Engineer

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Offer authorization for Elias Moreno — Sr. Serving Engineer

Team,

Elias finished the final onsite yesterday — interview feedback is very strong across runtime, routing, and comp-systems. He has a competing offer with an internal deadline next Wednesday. Marcus and I recommend moving quickly.

Ask: authorization to extend an offer at base $215,000 + 20% target bonus (equity TBD) within band with a request for an exception to the top of band if needed. Candidate expects total comp in the high 200ks.

Rationale:
- Excellent fit for serving runtime ownership + kernel tuning experience.
- Has a production inference background and immediate ability to lead a 2-person cross-functional effort.
- Strong counteroffer from another FAANG-like company; timeline is tight.

Attachments: Elias_Moreno_Resume.pdf

Marcus, please confirm manager-level justification and whether you want market/top-of-band exception. Mina — can you confirm target equity range and what the offer packet should include?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Offer authorization for Elias Moreno — Sr. Serving Engineer

Karthik —

Thanks. Quick update from compensation perspective: the published band for Sr. Serving Engineer is $155,000–$200,000 base. Top-of-band exceptions require VP signoff.

I pulled comparable Greenhouse comp data and current market intel — attaching latest comp_band_schedule.xlsx. My recommendation (given counteroffer) is: request an exception to $215,000 base (95th pctile) + 20% target bonus and start with 0.5%–0.75% equity target (RSU-style, vesting schedule standard).

We also need a short manager justification memo for People Ops and finance headcount code for the offer template. I can draft the offer packet once I have signoff.

Attachments: comp_band_schedule.xlsx

—Mina

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. A couple of compliance/process notes before we proceed:

1) For any exception above published band (>$200k base) we need VP approval (Lauren).
2) Please include the manager justification paragraph (2–3 sentences) that explicitly addresses unique skills and business criticality.
3) Finance needs the headcount code (GL/req number) before we generate the official offer letter; Marcus, can you send that?

If Lauren approves the exception, People Ops can greenlight and I will run the formal offer paperwork through Legal for redlines.

Laura
Head of People Operations

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Thanks for pulling this together. I reviewed the comp schedule and the manager notes in-line (Marcus — thanks for the level-specific details). Given the candidate quality and the immediate product roadblock Elias will unblock, I approve an exception to $215,000 base (one-time exception approved to the 95th percentile).

Conditions:
- Equity target capped at 0.75% for initial grant; cycle per standard offer cadence.
- Compensation approval is contingent on Finance confirming headcount code and Legal finishing a standard review of the offer_template.pdf (no special clauses).
- Keep total cash within the published budget for the hire band if possible — get approval from me if you need to go above the number authorized here.

Please proceed to finalize the offer. Laura / Mina — if you need anything else, ping me.

—Lauren
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Ana / Offers team —

We have final internal authorization to extend an offer to Elias Moreno for Senior Serving Engineer. Approved comp: $215,000 base + 20% target bonus; equity target 0.5%–0.75% (final grant to be set by Offers team). Laura will run the paperwork through Legal.

Please use the attached offer_template.pdf and include the following in the manager justification section of the packet: 
"Elias brings production inference experience with kernel optimizations and cross-stack ownership; he will lead the serving runtime performance initiative and accelerate our latency/cost goals. Hiring him now closes a critical gap on a prioritized roadmap item."

Attachments to include in the packet: Elias_Moreno_Resume.pdf, comp_band_schedule.xlsx, offer_template.pdf

Greenhouse candidate: https://app.greenhouse.io/candidates/43281
Doc sign target: please try to get signed before candidate deadline on 2026-12-16.

Mina — will you coordinate candidate-facing logistics and set expectations on timeline? Marcus — please send the finance headcount code ASAP so Laura can trigger the offer letter generation.

Thanks everyone — moving fast on this one.
